title: Qatar to Philippines remittance: onboarding and screening decision rules
notes: VERSION ZERO. Drafted from public regulator material by the CorridorComply team and NOT reviewed by a compliance professional. Every threshold and document choice below must be confirmed against QCB instructions, BSP/AMLC rules and the firm's own risk assessment before use. Rules that encode facts (ID number formats, list mechanics) are testable; rules that encode judgement are placeholders for an advisor to correct.
sources: State of Qatar Law No. 20 of 2019 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing (as amended)
Qatar Central Bank AML/CFT instructions for exchange houses (to be cited by section after review)
Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas and AMLC rules for remittance and transfer companies (to be cited after review)
FATF High-Risk Jurisdictions subject to a Call for Action (current list)
Qatar ID number structure: century digit, birth year, ISO numeric nationality (public documentation)
PhilSys Card Number format (Philippine Statistics Authority)

national_lists: Qatar National Counter Terrorism Committee designations (NOT LOADED YET)

documents.label: Qatar ID card (QID)
documents.notes: Primary ID for residents. Number encodes birth year and nationality; cross-checked against stated DOB and nationality.

documents.label: Passport
documents.notes: Accepted with a valid Qatar visa or entry for non-residents; MRZ verified.

sending.notes: Most senders are migrant workers paid under the Wage Protection System; salary card statements are a common source-of-funds document.

receiving.notes: Beneficiary identity is verified by the paying partner at payout; the sender-side record must carry the fields the partner needs under Recommendation 16.

rules.title: Confirmed sanctions match
rules.reason: High-confidence name match with agreeing date of birth on a sanctions list. Treat as a true match: do not proceed, freeze, escalate to the MLRO, consider an STR.
rules.basis: UNSC resolutions implemented under Qatar law; FATF R.6 targeted financial sanctions

rules.title: High-confidence match, DOB not comparable
rules.reason: High-confidence name match but the list entry or the customer has no date of birth to compare. A reviewer must confirm or clear.
rules.basis: FATF R.10 CDD; firm screening procedure

rules.title: High-confidence name match, DOB differs
rules.reason: Name matches a listed person but the date of birth differs: probable namesake. Record the disposition with the DOB evidence.

rules.title: Medium-confidence match
rules.reason: Medium-confidence name similarity to a listed person. Reviewer decides with nationality and DOB evidence.

rules.title: Matched on a listed alias
rules.reason: The hit was on an alias rather than the primary listed name; show the reviewer which alias.

rules.title: Single-name customer without a date of birth
rules.reason: A single-token name cannot be screened meaningfully without a date of birth. Obtain DOB from the ID before onboarding.
rules.basis: Firm screening procedure; common on South Asian corridors

rules.title: Qatar ID birth year does not match stated DOB
rules.reason: The birth year encoded in the QID number differs from the date of birth supplied. Possible data entry error or borrowed identity.

rules.title: Qatar ID nationality does not match stated nationality
rules.reason: The nationality encoded in the QID number differs from the nationality supplied.

rules.title: Identity number is not well-formed
rules.reason: The identity number does not match the published format for that document. Check for a typo before assuming fraud.

rules.title: Required onboarding fields missing
rules.reason: One or more fields the corridor requires for CDD are missing.
rules.basis: FATF R.10; QCB CDD requirements (cite after review)

rules.title: Identity document expired
rules.reason: The identity document has expired. A valid document is required before onboarding.
rules.basis: FATF R.10 reliable, independent source documents

rules.title: Selfie does not match the document photo
rules.reason: Face comparison between selfie and document failed. Manual verification required; possible third-party use of a worker's ID.
rules.basis: Firm CDD procedure; corridor typology (borrowed identity)

rules.title: Customer from a FATF call-for-action jurisdiction
rules.reason: Enhanced due diligence required for customers connected to a jurisdiction subject to a FATF call for action.
rules.basis: FATF R.19; QCB instructions on high-risk countries

rules.title: Beneficiary identity number not well-formed
rules.reason: The beneficiary ID number does not match the Philippine format given. Correct before sending, or the payout partner will reject.
rules.basis: FATF R.16 beneficiary information; payout partner requirements

rules.title: Beneficiary record incomplete
rules.reason: The beneficiary record lacks fields the receiving side requires.

rules.title: Sender under 18
rules.basis: Firm policy (confirm minimum age with QCB instructions)
